description: `x-formspec-class-scope: null` — the JSON idiom for explicit no-config. Schema-valid and identical to absence, the same idiom `x-formspec-actor-scope` uses.
adrRow: §5.1 `x-formspec-class-scope` … `null` ≡ absent (same idiom as actor-scope); `{}` is schema-invalid.
note: Both layers agree, and the agreement is the idiom: `null` says 'I considered class scope and declared none', which is exactly absence — nothing to enforce, so nothing can fail open. This is the deliberate counterpart to the sibling `invalid-class-scope-empty-object`, which both layers refuse: `{}` is key-presence without content, declared intent whose content cannot be read. The two fixtures together draw the line. `minProperties` bites on the object branch only, so widening the type to object-or-null keeps `{}` invalid while admitting `null`.
